research_answers.question: 官方研究中有哪些从辅助转向执行的具体工作模式？
research_answers.answer: 现有官方 RSS 摘要只能确认两个宽泛方向：企业正在采用智能体 AI，并在工作中使用 ChatGPT 与 Codex。摘要没有列出可复现的具体执行模式、步骤、角色分工、交付物或验收方式。
research_answers.remaining_gap: 需要官方全文或等效的一手材料，核验从辅助到执行的具体工作模式及其上下文；当前摘要不足以回答“具体有哪些”。

research_answers.question: RingCentral 案例里哪些做法适合抽象为个人任务模板？
research_answers.answer: 可谨慎抽象出两类模板方向：一是围绕 AI 产品开发组织任务输入与交付物，二是把分散的工程和运营信息集中到统一任务上下文。作为个人演示，可进一步把合成产品请求整理为明确交付物和验收清单；这是基于案例摘要与实验目录所做的任务设计，不代表 RingCentral 原文披露了这套个人模板。
research_answers.remaining_gap: RSS 摘要未提供 RingCentral 的具体流程、工具配置、输入资料、责任分工和验收方法，因此只能做有限抽象，不能归因于其完整实践。

research_answers.question: 选择什么非敏感日常任务最适合演示完整执行与验收？
research_answers.answer: 选择“把一条合成的产品需求转换为交付物与验收清单”。任务使用虚构材料，不涉及个人或企业敏感信息；输入、执行步骤、交付物和逐项验收条件都容易展示，适合完成一张可复用任务执行卡和一个可检查的小成品。

deliverable.title: Current Note Markdown Export — Action Brief
deliverable.objective: Add an export button to the fictional notes app that downloads the currently selected note as a Markdown file while correctly handling ready, no-note-selected, and export-failure states.
decisions: Export only the currently selected note.
Use Markdown as the sole export format.
Exclude cloud synchronization and PDF export from scope.
Provide explicit UI behavior for ready, no note selected, and export failure states.
Use the note title as the basis for the downloaded filename.
Preserve headings and lists in the exported Markdown content.

actions.task: Define the export button behavior for all required states.
actions.next_step: Specify the button's enabled state, disabled or explanatory no-selection state, and visible failure feedback.
actions.acceptance_condition: The interface has defined behavior for ready, no note selected, and export failure states.

actions.task: Implement current-note Markdown serialization and download.
actions.next_step: Connect the export button to serialize the selected note as Markdown and trigger a local file download named from the note title.
actions.acceptance_condition: Selecting a note and activating export downloads a Markdown file whose filename uses the note title and whose content preserves headings and lists.

actions.task: Test the export flow and scope boundaries.
actions.next_step: Test successful export, no-selection behavior, simulated export failure, filename generation, Markdown structure, and absence of PDF or cloud-sync features.
actions.acceptance_condition: All acceptance checklist items pass without adding PDF export or cloud synchronization.

acceptance_checklist: In the ready state, activating the export button downloads the currently selected note as a Markdown file.
The downloaded filename uses the selected note's title.
Exported headings retain valid Markdown heading structure.
Exported lists retain valid Markdown list structure.
When no note is selected, the app does not attempt an export and presents the defined no-selection state.
When export fails, the app presents the defined failure state and does not indicate success.
No cloud synchronization functionality is added.
No PDF export functionality is added.
risks: Note titles may contain characters that are invalid or unsafe in filenames and require sanitization.
The notes app's internal content representation is unspecified, which may affect how headings and lists are converted to Markdown.
The expected UI presentation and recovery behavior for export failures are not specified.
Duplicate or empty note titles may require a filename fallback or collision policy.

assumptions: The app already exposes the currently selected note's title and content to the export feature.
Export is a client-side file download rather than a server-side operation.
Filename sanitization may be applied while still basing the filename on the note title.
Preserving headings and lists means retaining their semantic structure as valid Markdown, not necessarily preserving visual styling.
missing_inputs: The notes app's technology stack and internal note-content format are not provided.
The desired button placement, label, and visual design are not provided.
The exact error message and retry behavior for export failure are not provided.
Filename rules for empty, duplicate, or invalid note titles are not provided.

Converted the requirements into decisions, owned actions, acceptance checks, risks, assumptions, and missing inputs.

deliverable.title: Current Note Markdown Export Action Brief
deliverable.objective: Add an export button to the fictional notes app that downloads the currently selected note as Markdown, with explicit handling for ready, no-note-selected, and export-failure states. Exclude cloud sync and PDF export.
decisions: Export only the current note as Markdown.
Support three required states: ready, no note selected, and export failure.
Use the note title for the downloaded filename.
Preserve headings and lists in the exported Markdown.

actions.task: Implement the Markdown export control and download behavior.
actions.next_step: Add an export button that serializes the selected note to Markdown and initiates a local file download named from the note title.
actions.acceptance_condition: With a note selected, activating export downloads a Markdown file whose filename uses the note title and whose content preserves headings and lists.

actions.next_step: Define and implement the export button behavior when no note is selected.
actions.acceptance_condition: When no note is selected, the interface presents a clear non-exportable state and does not download a file.

actions.next_step: Catch export or download failures and expose a visible failure state.
actions.acceptance_condition: When export fails, no false success is shown and the user receives a clear failure indication.

actions.next_step: Test successful export, no-note-selected behavior, export failure, filename generation, Markdown preservation, and excluded features.
actions.acceptance_condition: All checklist items pass, and neither cloud sync nor PDF export is introduced.

acceptance_checklist: A selected note can be exported as a downloaded Markdown file.
The downloaded filename uses the note title.
The ready state permits export of the current note.
The no-note-selected state prevents download and is clearly represented.
An export failure produces a clear failure indication without reporting success.
risks: Filename behavior is underspecified for empty titles or characters invalid in filenames.
The expected UI treatment for the no-note-selected and export-failure states is unspecified.
The source note data model and its Markdown serialization rules are unspecified.
Browser or runtime download constraints may affect implementation behavior.

assumptions: “Uses the note title” means the title forms the downloaded filename with a Markdown file extension.
“Preserves headings and lists” means those structures remain valid Markdown structures after export.
Implementation and test owners remain unassigned because no people or roles were supplied.
missing_inputs: Implementation owner and test owner assignments.
Expected behavior for untitled notes and filename-invalid characters.
Required UI copy and visual treatment for no-note-selected and export-failure states.
The fictional app’s technology stack, note data model, and existing export interfaces.
A defined way to trigger or simulate export failure during testing.
steps_taken: Extracted the explicit scope, exclusions, required states, and acceptance requirements from the synthetic input.
Converted the requested work into owned action items without inventing named owners.
Mapped every action to a checkable acceptance condition.
Recorded risks, assumptions, and missing inputs.
Checked the output against all catalog acceptance criteria and the strict schema.

self_check.evidence: The deliverable contains a titled, checkable action brief for Markdown export.
Title, objective, decisions, actions, acceptance checklist, and risks are all populated.
Unknown ownership, UI details, edge cases, technical context, and failure simulation are explicitly listed.
Each action includes a task, an explicit unassigned owner label, a next step, and an acceptance condition.
The checklist covers successful export, filename, structural preservation, required states, and scope exclusions.
Interpretations of filename usage and Markdown preservation are labeled as assumptions rather than facts.
The response is one JSON object containing only schema-defined fields and valid criterion identifiers.
The brief is independently checkable; unresolved implementation details are isolated as missing inputs rather than silently invented.
